ana (partnerops): FYI: VertexEdge sent today's usage dump with mixed unit_type values (requests, cpu_seconds) and some items missing utc_reported_at. invoice previews show duplicated charges for a handful of SMB customers.

jordan (eng): can you paste a tiny redacted example?

ana (partnerops): pasted: ```json
{"customer_id":"vtx-42","unit_type":"requests","units":200,"utc_reported_at":"2026-03-15T14:00:00Z","event_id":"ev-111"}
{"customer_id":"vtx-42","unit_type":"cpu_seconds","units":1200,"reported_at_local":"2026-03-15T06:00:00-08:00","event_id":"ev-111"}
```

tess (payments): that's the same event_id with two unit types — our SKU mapper will create two line items. not ideal.

kai (marketplace): policy: partners should report canonical SKU/unit for the marketplace SKU. we shouldn't silently convert one to another without partner opt-in.

jordan (eng): current ingest behavior: accept whatever unit_type, normalize timestamp if utc_reported_at present, otherwise try to parse reported_at_local but we don't fail on unknown or missing fields. so we end up with duplicates when event_id collides.

ana (partnerops): VertexEdge said their edge SDK rolled out a lib that switched metric naming on some nodes. they can resend a cleaned payload in ~45m.

tess (payments): short-term mitigation: hold VertexEdge hourly ingestion and mark affected customers as "under review" so nightly billing preview excludes the suspect rows. then once clean batch comes in we run a reconcile.

jordan (eng): medium-term: two changes: 1) make utc_reported_at strongly preferred and emit an ingest_warning if missing; 2) dedupe by event_id+partner_id after normalizing timestamp to UTC and ignore subsequent events where event_id matches and unit_type differs unless partner has opted-in to conversion.

kai (marketplace): add partner_profile flag convert_unit_types (default false) so partner ops can enable conversions for legacy partners. conversions must be explicit mapping stored in partner_profiles.

anа (partnerops): i'll tell VertexEdge to resend and share the conversion guidance doc. also requesting a backfill window: 2026-03-15T13:30Z-15:00Z.

jordan (eng): backfill plan (staging first): run idempotent dedupe job to tag duplicates by event_id, run invoice_preview_recompute for affected customers, and if preview delta > $20 then queue manual review. sample detection SQL: ```sql
select event_id, partner_id, array_agg(distinct unit_type) as types, count(*) as cnt
from partner_ledger
where partner_id='vertexedge' and ingested_at between '2026-03-15T13:30:00Z' and '2026-03-15T15:00:00Z'
group by event_id, partner_id
having count(distinct unit_type) > 1;
```

tess (payments): i'll prepare a credits playbook if we need to adjust invoices.

ingest-bot: action scheduled: pause-ingest vertexedge at 2026-03-15T15:10:00Z by kai

ana (partnerops): owners: jordan (ingest + backfill), tess (billing verification), kai (pause + partner flag), ana (partner comms). i'll update the partner-facing note with UTC requirement and unit_type whitelist. :thumbsup:
